sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Land Laws Second Amendment Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2009
ACT III OF 2009
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LAND
LAWS (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act to repeal the
North-West Frontier
Province Land Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008 and
further to amend certain land laws
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary,
4th February, 2009]
No. PA:/NWFP/Bill/2009/4062,
dated 4-2-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Land Laws (Second Amendment)
Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on 21st January, 2009 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 29th
January, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
the North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient to repeal the North-West
Frontier Province Land Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008 (N.-W.F.P. Ord.No.XV of 2008), and further to amend certain land laws;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the North-West Frontier Province Land Laws (Second Amendment)
Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 7th October, 2008..
